verdict.rationale: Relay lets admins issue cards with configurable spend limits, define roles, and split funds across up to 20 sub-accounts, which can approximate department/program budgeting with enforced card limits (relay-docs-1, relay-docs-2). However, there's no explicit 'budget' object with cumulative spend caps or alerts across a program, and community reviews note occasional 'problems with prescribed limits' (relay-comm-2), suggesting enforcement isn't always seamless. Missing for 10: dedicated budget-creation UI/API distinct from per-card limits, evidence of automatic alerts/blocks when a department's aggregate spend is exceeded, and independent confirmation that limits are reliably enforced.
